question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing left winger, Bob is playing right back, and Claire is playing left midfielder.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Alice and Claire trade positions. Then, Claire and Bob trade positions. Finally, Alice and Bob trade positions. At the end of the match, Alice is playing
Options:
(A) left winger
(B) right back
(C) left midfielder
solution:
Player order: Alice | Bob | Claire
Initial: left winger | right back | left midfielder
1. Alice ↔ Claire: left midfielder | right back | left winger
2. Claire ↔ Bob: left midfielder | left winger | right back
3. Alice ↔ Bob: left winger | left midfielder | right back
Alice plays left winger, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
